points.description: Initialisation and input sampling: arranges weights in a lattice/topology, initialises them randomly (all different), and samples an input vector from the input space.

Core loop: finds the winning neuron by similarity matching (best match to the input), updates the winner and its neighbours using the neighbourhood function, reduces neighbourhood radius/learning rate, and repeats sampling until ordering and convergence are complete (then stops). Equivalent wording or standard pseudo code notation accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half if winner selection and weight update are given but the decay of parameters or the stopping/repeat condition is missing.
